versions.content: Hardware Resetting Function on Bus Driver The FlexRay Transceiver Driver shall provide a method that reinitializes BD’s functionality Hint: When trouble occurs in the hardware level, it is likely to fix the cause by resetting the hardware. This function shall be executed when a configurable amount of errors are detected in by the FlexRay modules and have been reported to DEM.
